[{"TABLE_ID":"nbds-transaksi-detail","MENU_ID":"nbds-transaksi-valas","DATASOURCE_ID":"NBDS","TABLE_TITLE":"Detail Transaksi Valas","TONE":"info","PAGE_SIZE":10,"SQL_TEXT":"SELECT

    CASE
        WHEN t.TYPE = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL_VALAS' THEN 'Tarik Tunai'
        WHEN t.TYPE = 'CASH_DEPOSIT_VALAS' THEN 'Setor Tunai'
        WHEN t.TYPE = 'PAYMENT' THEN 'Pembayaran'
        WHEN t.TYPE = 'EXCHANGE_VALAS' THEN 'Jual-Beli Valas'
        WHEN t.TYPE = 'FOREIGN_CURRENCY' AND t.TRANSFER_METHOD = 'TELEGPRAHIC_TRANSFER' THEN 'Transfer Valuta Asing/TT'
        WHEN t.TYPE = 'FOREIGN_CURRENCY' AND t.TRANSFER_METHOD = 'AMEND_TT' THEN 'Pengubahan Transfer Valuta Asing/TT'
        WHEN t.TYPE = 'RETURN_SKNBI' THEN 'Retur SKNBI'
        WHEN t.TYPE = 'EC_ADD_UNDERLYING' THEN 'Penambahan Underlying EC'
        WHEN t.TYPE = 'TRANSFER' THEN 'Transfer Sesama Mandiri'
        WHEN t.TYPE = 'KLIRING_INKASO' THEN 'Warkat/Kliring'
        WHEN t.TYPE = 'TRANSFER_ANOTHER_BANK' AND t.TRANSFER_METHOD = 'BI_NATIONAL_CLEARING_VALAS' THEN 'SKNBI'
        ELSE 'Lainnya (' || t.TYPE || ')'
    END                         AS jenis_transaksi,
    t.CURRENCY                  AS valuta,
    t.AMOUNT                    AS nominal,
    t.BENEFICIARY_CURRENCY      AS valuta_penerima,
    t.AMOUNT_RECEIVE            AS nominal_diterima
FROM RESERVATION.TRANSACTIONS t
LEFT JOIN RESERVATION.RESERVATIONS r ON t.RESERVATION_ID = r.ID
LEFT JOIN CONFIG.BRANCHES b ON b.BRANCH_CODE = r.BRANCH_CODE
WHERE (t.CURRENCY != 'IDR' OR t.BENEFICIARY_CURRENCY != 'IDR')
  AND t.CREATED_TIME >= :startDate
  AND t.CREATED_TIME < :endDate
ORDER BY t.CREATED_TIME DESC, t.ID DESC

        WHEN 'WAIT_GENERAL_BANKER_CONFIRMATION'    THEN 'Menunggu Konfirmasi GB'

        WHEN 'IN_PROCESS'                          THEN 'Sedang Diproses'

    overall_unique_cif,
    overall_total_hit,
    overall_total_tagihan,
    success_unique_cif,
    success_total_hit,
    success_total_tagihan,
    failed_unique_cif,
    failed_total_hit,
    failed_total_tagihan
FROM (

        TRUNC(trx.transaction_time)                                                AS tanggal,
        COUNT(DISTINCT trx.from_cif)                                               AS overall_unique_cif,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pm.REFERENCE_TRANSACTION_ID)                                                  AS overall_total_hit,
        NVL(SUM(trx.amount), 0)                                                    AS overall_total_tagihan,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN trx.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN trx.from_cif END)     AS success_unique_cif,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN trx.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN pm.REFERENCE_TRANSACTION_ID END)        AS success_total_hit,
        NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN trx.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN trx.amount END), 0)          AS success_total_tagihan,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN trx.status = 'FAILED'  THEN trx.from_cif END)     AS failed_unique_cif,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN trx.status = 'FAILED'  THEN pm.REFERENCE_TRANSACTION_ID END)        AS failed_total_hit,
        NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN trx.status = 'FAILED'  THEN trx.amount END), 0)          AS failed_total_tagihan,
        TRUNC(trx.transaction_time)                                                AS sort_col
    FROM  payment.payment_trx trx
    JOIN payment.PAYMENT_STAGE stg 
        ON trx.TRANSACTION_ID = stg.TRANSACTION_ID 
    JOIN payment.PAYMENT_MULTIPLE pm 
        ON stg.REFERENCE_TRANSACTION_ID = pm.REFERENCE_TRANSACTION_ID 
    WHERE TRUNC(trx.transaction_time) 
        BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
    GROUP BY TRUNC(trx.transaction_time)

)
ORDER BY sort_col

        WHEN 'WAIT_GENERAL_BANKER_CONFIRMATION'    THEN 'Menunggu Konfirmasi GB'
        WHEN 'NEED_CONFIRMATION'                   THEN 'Perlu Konfirmasi'
        WHEN 'IN_PROCESS'                          THEN 'Sedang Diproses'
        WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS'                         THEN 'Sedang Diproses'
        WHEN 'SUCCESS'                             THEN 'Berhasil'
        WHEN 'FAILED'                              THEN 'Gagal'
        ELSE TNF.STATUS
    END AS TRANSACTION_STATUS,
    LPAD(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (COALESCE(R.END_TIME, TNF.UPDATED_TIME) - R.START_TIME)), 2, '0') || ':' ||
    LPAD(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (COALESCE(R.END_TIME, TNF.UPDATED_TIME) - R.START_TIME)), 2, '0') || ':' ||
    LPAD(TRUNC(EXTRACT(SECOND FROM (COALESCE(R.END_TIME, TNF.UPDATED_TIME) - R.START_TIME))), 2, '0')
    AS DURATION
FROM
    RESERVATION.TRANSACTIONS_NON_FINANCIAL TNF
    INNER JOIN RESERVATION.RESERVATIONS R
        ON TNF.RESERVATION_ID = R.ID
WHERE
    TNF.TYPE = 'ACCOUNT_CLOSURE'
    AND TNF.SERVICE_CATEGORY = 'GOLD_ACCOUNT_CLOSURE'
    AND TNF.CREATED_TIME >= :startDate

ITEMS AS (
    SELECT
        T.TNF_ID            AS TNF_ID,
        JT.ITEM_NO          AS ITEM_NO,
        MAX(JT.PRODUCT_TYPE) AS PRODUCT_TYPE,
        MAX(JT.PARTNER_NAME) AS PARTNER_NAME,
        MAX(JT.ITEM_COUNT)   AS ITEM_COUNT,
        SUM(JT.WEIGHT)       AS WEIGHT
    FROM TRX T
    CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        T.DETAILS,
        '$.goldItems[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            ITEM_NO      FOR ORDINALITY,
            PARTNER_NAME VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.partnerName',
            PRODUCT_TYPE VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.productType',
            ITEM_COUNT   NUMBER       PATH '$.count',
            NESTED PATH '$.goldDetail[*]'
            COLUMNS (
                WEIGHT NUMBER PATH '$.weight'
            )
        )
    ) JT
    GROUP BY T.TNF_ID, JT.ITEM_NO
)

        TO_DATE(SUBSTR(T.RESERVATION_AT, 1, 10), 'DD-MM-YYYY'),
        'YYYY-MM-DD'

    T.BRANCH_NAME           AS BRANCH_NAME,

    I.PARTNER_NAME          AS GOLD_BRAND,

    I.WEIGHT                AS WEIGHT,

        WHEN 'CANCEL_BY_GENERAL_BANKER'         THEN 'Dibatalkan oleh GB'

        WHEN 'WAIT'                             THEN 'Menunggu'

        WHEN 'WAIT_GENERAL_BANKER_CONFIRMATION' THEN 'Menunggu Konfirmasi GB'
        WHEN 'NEED_CONFIRMATION'                THEN 'Perlu Konfirmasi'
        WHEN 'IN_PROCESS'                       THEN 'Sedang Diproses'
        WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS'                      THEN 'Sedang Diproses'
        WHEN 'SUCCESS'                          THEN 'Berhasil'
        WHEN 'FAILED'                           THEN 'Gagal'
        ELSE T.STATUS
    END                     AS TRANSACTION_STATUS,
    CASE
        WHEN T.DUR_SEC IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE TO_CHAR(TRUNC(T.DUR_SEC / 3600), 'FM9999900') || ':' ||
             TO_CHAR(TRUNC(MOD(T.DUR_SEC, 3600) / 60), 'FM00') || ':' ||
             TO_CHAR(MOD(T.DUR_SEC, 60), 'FM00')
    END                     AS DURATION
FROM TRX T
INNER JOIN ITEMS I
